primitives.node: A discrete structural unit (layer, statute set, duty cluster).
primitives.edge: A directional relationship or dependency between nodes.
primitives.surface: A region where multiple edges converge, often representing collapse points or contradictions.
primitives.operator: A geometric transformation applied to nodes/edges/surfaces to reveal structure.

edges.description: Federal statutes impose duties that intersect with municipal enforcement obligations.
Municipal failures create conditions for mandamus review.
Judicial immunity and administrative boundaries shape mandamus viability.
Federal statutes define extraterritorial applicability for embassy conduct.
Disability barriers affect access to mandamus and procedural remedies.
HRD retaliation patterns inform federal LE conflict assessment.
Federal LE conflicts influence mandamus pathways.
Stage‑2 remains locked until federal statute pathways are exhausted.

surfaces.label: Municipal Collapse Surface
surfaces.description: Intersection of municipal nondiscretionary duties, mandamus prerequisites, and disability barriers.

surfaces.label: Federal Conflict Surface
surfaces.description: Region where federal statutes, HRD retaliation patterns, and LE conflicts converge.

surfaces.label: Extraterritoriality Surface
surfaces.description: Region mapping extraterritorial statute applicability to embassy conduct.

operators.label: Holonomy Operator
operators.description: Detects loops in jurisdictional flows (e.g., municipal → judicial → municipal).

operators.label: Modal Lattice Operator
operators.description: Separates judicial vs administrative acts within the judicial branch.

operators.label: Collapse Surface Detector
operators.description: Identifies structural contradictions or remedy failures across surfaces.

operators.label: Spectral Bundle Operator
operators.description: Maps interactions between federal statutes and downstream duty flows.
